user_has_role(user, role) :- member(user, group), grant(group, role).
user_has_role(user, included_role) :- user_has_role(user, role), includes(role, included_role).

%% Determine if a user can perform an action on a resource
user_can_perform_action(user, resource, action) :- user_has_role(user, role), permit(role, resource, action).

%% Determine if a user is revoked from a resource
user_is_revoked(user, resource) :- revoked(user, resource).

%% Determine if a user can delete a resource but cannot read it
user_can_delete_but_not_read(user, resource) :- user_can_perform_action(user, resource, 'delete'), not user_can_perform_action(user, resource, 'read'), not user_is_revoked(user, resource).
